name: Mint tea
description: Fresh mint steeped alone (Maghrebi style adds green tea).

ayurveda.note: Pudina is classically shita, used to settle a hot stomach.

histamine.note: One of the safest hot drinks when reactive.

nutrition.highlight: caffeine-free unless green tea goes in too

effects.note: A standard after-meal glass across Middle Eastern, South Asian and Mediterranean households, taken to settle the stomach once the food is down. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
